title: Smoke fits - A1: each outcome's exposure effect, rate ratio
caption: From each fit's draws file. A row is one outcome, a panel one exposure and effect; the dashed line is no effect. Each outcome's own rate ratio, per year for the slope. 12 fits. Smoke fits only: 10 draws per effect, so every number here is noise; the figure shows what the results will look like, not a result.

title: Smoke fits - A1: each outcome's exposure effect, relative to total purchases

Smoke fits only: 10 draws per effect, so every number here is noise; the figure shows what the results will look like, not a result.
